label: Same-sex marriage legalization year
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = a curated table of dated national legislation (33 countries, 2001-2025, one citation per point — statute or nationwide ruling with its effective date, the consensus dating cross-checked against the legislative record); no witness tier exists (no machine-readable door carries the series — probed live 2026-09-20, the curation gate's condition (b) finding).
license: Facts with citation (small extracts, clearly attributed) — see docs/licenses.md and catalog/curated/README.md.
notes:
THE TENTH INDICATOR, THE FIRST MARKER (v15). The corpus's family 'markers' = Todd's dated institutional events — the thresholds his method reads as STATE ZERO points, not curves. This one (13 citations, La Défaite de l'Occident 2024 — the single-book metric with the corpus's heaviest per-book concentration outside the #1) is Todd's 'religion zero' marker: the year a country legalizes same-sex marriage dates the moment its Christian norm system stopped being state-bearing (his chain: 2015 -> Trump -> Ukraine war reads from these very dates — Ireland's referendum and Obergefell both 2015, the US marker the chain's hinge).
THE MARKER'S SHAPE: one point per country, the point's year = the legalization year, the value = the same year (the board reads a STEP: France 2013, Germany 2017, Greece 2024 — the Orthodox world's first, the marker family's own divergence display). Every point carries its citation in the dist (the statute or nationwide ruling, with its effective date) and a definition_note spelling the dating convention: the year the FIRST NATIONAL law took effect (a statute's entry into force, not its signature; a nationwide court ruling where the statute never preceded one — Obergefell 2015, Colombia 2016, Austria 2019's court-ordered effective date; a referendum's year where the people voted first — Ireland 2015, Switzerland's 2021 referendum approval with the 2022 entry into force). Sub-national firsts (Massachusetts 2004, Mexico City 2010) and the registered- partnership history (Denmark 1989, the world's first) ride in the definition_notes, never in the value — the marker is the NATIONAL marriage date, as Todd reads it.
THE CURATION GATE (ADR-0007, all three conditions): (a) the todd_ref demands it — 13 citations in La Défaite de l'Occident, the 'religion zero' chain's own dating instrument; (b) the distortion is the ABSENCE — no collector or harmonized door carries the series at all (probed live: OWID 404 on every candidate slug, the collectors print vital statistics, not statutes), so the curated tier is not competing with a wire, it is the only tier; (c) every row carries its citation — enforced mechanically by the connector (an empty citation column is a parse error).
HONEST SCOPE LIMITS: 33 countries = the countries with a national same-sex marriage law in force as of the 2025 vintage (the table's coverage ends at Thailand and Liechtenstein 2025); the countries where marriage remains unlegalized have NO row (an absent row is the honest state — a 0 would invent a date); the couples' registered- partnership intermediate step (Denmark 1989 onward) is deliberately NOT the marker, per Todd's own usage.
